explicit_statements: CUSTOMER VOICE IS JM1'S DEFAULT MICROSOFT-NATIVE FEEDBACK PLATFORM WHERE SURVEY/FEEDBACK SEMANTICS FIT.
CV-01 IS ACTIVATION, NOT SURVEY-PLATFORM DESIGN.
enterprise_capability_ownership: J Merrill One owns Customer Voice capability governance, tenant configuration evidence, shared survey standards, Dataverse integration boundaries, privacy/security rules, reusable patterns, and cross-division handoff contracts.
division_ownership: Each division repository owns survey wording, website implementation, division branding, service recovery operations, and any division-specific business context.
environment_strategy: Prefer JM1-Enterprise-Dev for nonproduction proof; use JM1-Test where Microsoft architecture requires; do not begin directly in JM1-Core unless tenant-level provisioning inherently applies.
survey_project_strategy: Use distinct Customer Voice projects/surveys per division experience rather than one generic survey; Founder Brand coaching remains future-only.
identity_relationship: Enterprise Contact is canonical; a person may have multiple governed division relationships.
response_storage: Customer Voice/Dataverse owns survey response storage; do not create duplicate response tables.
privacy: Response visibility follows business context and division sensitivity.
consent: Survey response is not marketing consent and is not testimonial publication authorization.
website_presentation: Use a human-facing Share Your Experience link/button, normally in footer or client resources.
automation: Future invitations may use Customer Voice, Dataverse, and Power Automate triggers; automation is not required for public feedback links.
feedback_escalation: Low/serious feedback routes to division review; Cases are created only where service-resolution semantics fit.
testimonial_permission: Optional permission-to-contact about testimonial use is separate from feedback and publication authorization.
analytics: Use native Customer Voice/Dynamics operational reporting first; Power BI is later.
validation_gates: Customer Voice app provisioned in nonproduction
Contact/division context linkage validated where supported
production_activation_criteria: no licensing/capacity purchase required without approval
